sources.entry: ZOOOP - AI-native filmmaking workstation for text/image-to-video, lip-sync, and storyboarding on an infinite canvas. #freemium

summary.name: ZOOOP
summary.one_liner: ZOOOP is a browser-based AI creative platform that generates images, video, and audio on an infinite canvas, with single-purpose generator and tool pages and ready-made templates.
use_cases: text or image to video clips
creating images with multiple AI models
producing voiceover and music with AI
summary.what_it_does: ZOOOP lets users generate images, videos, and audio in a browser, either on a shared infinite canvas or in focused single-shot generator pages. It aggregates many third-party models for each media type, including listed image models (such as GPT Image 2.5, Flux 2, Midjourney V8.2), video models (such as Kling V4, Seedance 2.5, Wan 3.0, Vidu Q4), and voice/music models (such as ElevenLabs, MiniMax, Google Lyria 3). Individual tool pages cover tasks like background removal and upscaling applied to your own assets, while templates package prompts and settings into starting points. Generations can be starred, grouped, and revisited in collections, and teams can co-edit canvases with roles and shared credits.
notable: Aggregates many third-party image, video, and voice models on one infinite canvas
Pay-as-you-go credits that never expire, with no subscription needed for solo use
Free team workspace with 10 free creator seats and live multiplayer canvas editing
caveats: Paid Pro plan costs $15/seat/month for teams needing more than 10 creators
Viewers can browse and download but cannot create
Generations rely on credits; the page does not list credit prices beyond the Pro seat price
